svg.title: coexist
svg.desc: coexist: a recorded terminal session, 7 s, looping. Steps: coexist: another plugin folder, another proxy, another marketplace, another program on the port

g.text: doctor: another proxy is a note, not a failure
a second setup changes no setting
another program on the port: no base url
and the launcher says it is not Mandrake
the proxy says who it is
Mandrake's proxy: the session goes through it
a base url from the shell is left alone

svg.text: coexist: another plugin folder, another proxy, another marketplace, another program on the port
